column2: Together, the agricultural sector and land use produce about 30% of Finland’s
greenhouse gas emissions that cause climate change.
In 2022, greenhouse gas emissions from agriculture accounted for 14% of all
emissions in Finland. Emissions decreased by 15% from 1990 to 2022, but in
the 2000s they have remained at the same level.
